subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A test made up entirely of multiple-choice, true/false, and matching questions, each with one single fixed correct answer that any examiner would score identically, is called a/an:
explanation: Objective-type tests have a single fixed correct answer, ensuring high scorer objectivity — contrasted with essay-type tests, scored more subjectively.
